text: Centralization of the code review industry produces overpricing because clients will pay nearly any price to obtain the stamp of approval from one of the top five audit firms.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

isBasedOn.name: AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning

abstract: As a result of the centralization of the industry, most code reviews are significantly overpriced. Clients pretty much pay any price to get the stamp of approval from one of the top 5 audit firms.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to the 2024 code review and audit market dominated by top firms
